entities.summary: Tyler Kenneth Kalinoski is an American professional basketball player for Unicaja of the Spanish Liga ACB and the FIBA Champions League (BCL). Kalinoski was a McDonald's All-American nominee as a senior at Olathe East High School in Kansas and completed his college career for the Davidson Wildcats. He was named Atlantic 10 Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year in 2015.
